search_window.basis: Since latest verified Food Line Source Watch heartbeat completed 20:47 PST on Nov. 7. Searches used a 3-day discovery lookback for indexing lag; only new nonduplicate food-access disruption evidence in this hourly interval would qualify.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall for four high-value miss classes; production nationwide collection remains authoritative and was not inspected or modified.
target_classes: Loss of only/sole/last/full-service community grocery store due to closure/fire/disaster
Emergency food distributions cancelled/suspended because of storm/flood/fire/outage/facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food bank service closure or major access reduction
Official new SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences

reviewed_exclusions.reason: Sole-grocery flood damage reported Nov. 6 but known from prior watches, not a new signal.
Provo food bank closure predates this window and was already excluded as duplicate.
Friday Nov. 6 emergency distribution remains listed; no cancellation notice; yesterday's local report said still scheduled.

Nov. 6 facility outage and in-person closure predates this interval, but SNAP applications continued by phone, online, and alternate center; WIC appointments by phone. Not a newly interrupted benefit/service.
Listed closures were dated Nov. 5-6 or earlier and no current new benefit-access interruption observed.
Standing call-center wait time delays and guidance are undated, not a newly established benefit interruption.
Nov. 2 EBT customer phone update is not an outage of benefits.
Provider distribution page did not show a verified newly canceled event in retrieved content.

Carrollton OH only-grocery closure occurred in January 2026 despite recent retrospective date; El Paso Sept. 2026 storm closure is old; 2025 SNAP shutdown articles, regular schedules, recruitment, promotions, and new-store openings are out of scope.

coverage_notes.assessment: No new source-verified, nonduplicate U.S. disruption in four specified classes found in 12 targeted search queries and seven successful direct checks since 20:47 PST.
coverage_notes.limitations: Bounded index-assisted recall, not exhaustive nationwide coverage. Publishing/indexing and provider updates may lag. Inability to prove the absence of unindexed local incidents; primary collector deduplication not inspected.
coverage_notes.action_limits: Append-only watch ledger heartbeat only. No approval, publication, schedule changes, task disabling, or production mutations.
